# Strategic Traders and Stochastic Games {#plan-ch23}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Planned
:::

Explains when market response depends on the beliefs and actions of other strategic participants, not only on exogenous noise.

**Subtopics.** Signaling through order flow; strategic liquidation; predatory trading; information leakage; equilibrium impact; best responses; stochastic differential games; mean-field games; competition among execution algorithms; mechanism design; limits of single-agent control models.
